overall: The Board did not violate the OML: the assistant's announcement that all members were remote, plus the chair's roll call, clearly identified the remote members.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board failed to announce the name of each member participating remotely at its October 29 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the combination of the Administrative Assistant’s announcement that all members were participating remotely followed by the roll call vote taken by the Chair clearly and effectively conveyed to the public the identity of all Board members who were participating remotely, and fulfilled the transparency goals of the Open Meeting Law.
